subtitle.neutral: Agents, what they run on and the runners leading them.

admin.title: Runner for this workspace
admin.offHint: Runner is off. Turn it on once; agents and their settings are then managed on this screen.
admin.onHint: Runner is on. Turning it off stops runners taking new tasks.
admin.disableConfirm: Turn Runner off? Runners finish current tasks and take no new ones.

agents.noOperator: No operator: listed because this workspace's runner leads it.

agents.unlisted: Runner settings for agents not in this list (another member's or removed):

profiles.hint: A profile is a launch recipe: which account (subscription or API key), which tool (Claude Code or Codex), which model and in which mode. Each agent is allowed some profiles; the runner picks one of them for every task, trying the first choice first.
profiles.allowedHelp: Profiles the runner may launch this agent with. Allow several so it can switch when one account runs out of quota.
